findings.title: withoutLeadingSlash returns slash for slash input
withFragment early return makes clearing fragment impossible
parseAuth truncates password at second colon
searchParams array values skip JSON stringify
withoutLeadingSlash returns slash for empty/root input
findings.claim: withoutLeadingSlash returns "/" for "" and "/" instead of removing the leading slash; the `|| "/"` fallback re-adds a slash.

findings.title: parseAuth truncates password containing colon
findings.claim: parseAuth splits on every ":" and keeps only the second part, so a password containing ":" is truncated.

findings.title: joinRelativeURL loses leading parent segments
findings.claim: joinRelativeURL tracks excess ".." with segmentsDepth but rebuilds with "../".repeat(-segmentsDepth), which undercounts when a normal segment follows leading ".." (e.g. ".."+"a" becomes "a" instead of "../a").

findings.title: withBase duplicates base when fragment follows
findings.claim: withBase treats "?" as a base boundary but not "#", so withBase("/foo#bar","/foo") duplicates the base via joinURL instead of returning input.

findings.title: withoutBase fails to strip base when fragment follows
findings.claim: withoutBase treats "?" as a base boundary but not "#", so withoutBase("/foo#bar","/foo") returns input unchanged instead of stripping to "/#bar".

findings.title: withFragment empty hash does not clear fragment
findings.claim: withFragment returns input unchanged for empty hash, contradicting documented withFragment("/foo#bar","") => "/foo"; the later `hash === ""` branch is unreachable.
